description: handle_email_parse (Email/parse, RFC 8621 §5.8) calls blob_exists() only when parse_email fails, correctly separating the two error cases: blob not found vs blob found but not parseable as an email. blob_exists is a required trait method (no default) since round 8 fix. This is the correct, defensible design per RFC 8621 §5.8.
title: Email/import correctly distinguishes notParsable from notFound via blob_exists()
